description: Find PixilUI items for a UI job. Describe what the interface has to do in plain words ("ask before the agent sends", "show tool calls with their output", "modal to confirm a delete"). Searches titles, descriptions, when-to-use notes and tags and returns the best matches first. Call this before writing any UI by hand.

category.description: Filter by category, for example ai, overlays, inputs, actions.

query.description: What the UI has to do, or the name of a component.

type.description: Filter by kind: foundation, component, pattern, block, screen or template.

name: search_items
title: Search components
